resources.string: Manage the AI request allowance in AI connection.

Android chooses the exact time. Updates may wait while your phone saves power.
MeBot will forget which items you opened. Previously read items may appear again. Saved items, conversations, preferences and relevance feedback will stay. This cannot be undone.

Open any item for its introduction and sources. Connected AI adds an explanation; ask a follow-up below.
Bookmark keeps a read in Saved. The star beside it follows a story. Manage follow-ups in Saved → Following; checks share your normal AI allowance.
